title: Fleet Labor Relief on Apportioned Mounting — Tire Sets & Treadwear Limited Warranty
content:
**Crestline Fleet Account labor relief on the apportioning mounting — Tire Sets & Treadwear Limited Warranty.** When a treadwear adjustment credit is apportioned between a workmanship share and the replacement ticket, the replacement ticket's mounting charge used in the apportioning base is relieved according to the vehicle's roster enrollment today:

| Vehicle today | Relieved from the mounting charge |
|---|---|
| enrolled on the roster of an active Crestline Fleet Account | 15% of the line's mount-and-balance charge per tire |
| enrolled on the roster of a Crestline Fleet Account that is not active | 5% of it |
| not enrolled on any roster | nothing |

A vehicle is enrolled today when it has a roster enrollment with no removal dated after it. The mounting charge less every relief taken off it is never below 0, and each relief is worked out on its own on the line's mount-and-balance charge per tire.

**Worked (hypothetical $30.00 mounting charge):** active account — $4.50 relieved; inactive account — $1.50 relieved; vehicle removed from its roster — nothing relieved.
